lex:
μαρτύρομαι
(μάρτυρ), [in LXX: Jdth.7:28, 1Ma.2:56 א)* ;]
to summon as witness (M, Th., 25 f.; Hort., 1Pe., 53 f.; Lft., Notes, 29; Ga 203), hence,
__(a) to protest, affirm solemnly: before ὅτι, Act.20:26, Gal.5:3;
__(b) to adjure, beseech: with dative of person(s), Act.26:22; with accusative and inf., Eph.4:17; before εἰς, 1Th.2:12 (cf. δια-, προ-μαρτύρομαι).†

strongs.def: to be adduced as a witness, i.e. (figuratively) to obtest (in affirmation or exhortation)
